title: Board Chair: Questions for the 07:00 Board Video Meeting

fields.exerciseAid: Exercise aid, not legal advice. Check the current rule and your counsel.
fields.to: Thomas Aldridge, Chief Executive Officer; General Counsel and Corporate Secretary; Chief Financial Officer; cc: Dr. Samuel Obuya, Audit Committee Chair; Karen Lindqvist, Risk and Technology Committee Chair
fields.from: Eleanor Whitcomb, Chair of the Board and Lead Independent Director, for the Board of Directors
fields.date: Friday, March 26, 2027, 6:56 a.m. Central Time (7:56 a.m. Eastern)
fields.subject: Board video meeting at 7:00 a.m. CT: what the board will ask and what it expects to decide
fields.handling: Confidential. Board communication. Sent by email and courier PDF because the board portal is unavailable. Corporate Secretary to minute it in full.
fields.situation: At 6:52 a.m. CT Midland Press Wire sent an UPDATE under the slug IRONCREST-CYBER: 'Ironcrest Machinery restored its manufacturing systems overnight, according to a person familiar with the company's response. Hackers posted what appear to be employee records late Thursday.' Directors did not tell anyone 'restored', and we want to know who did and whether it is true. We have the courier pre-read in front of us, along with three draft documents that do not agree with each other or with it.
known: The board portal is still down because single sign-on is isolated. The pre-read reached directors by courier PDF and will be read aloud at the start of the meeting.
Pre-read: 'employee data: under investigation; Rockford and Beloit systems affected.'
Form 8-K draft: 'Rockford and Beloit systems affected.'
COO's draft supply notice to Fieldmark Equipment and Granite Peak Machinery: 'temporary IT disruption.'
Employee all-hands note circulated last night: 'No employee personal data has been affected, all three plants are fully operational, and payroll is unaffected.'
The Rock River Gazette front page this morning reports leaked employee records and HD-4400 defense drawings.
Fieldmark has asked for a signed lot-traceability guarantee by 12:00 CT today.
unknown: Who gave Midland Press Wire the word 'restored', and whether any manufacturing system is actually back to the minimum service level at any plant.
Whether Blackwater Cyber has cleared a backup in writing, which systems the clearance covers, and whether the CISO has signed any system back into service.
What stops the attackers from coming back through the same door, and whether that door is now closed.
Which of the three drafts is accurate, and why the other two were written as they were.
Where the materiality determination stands, who made it, when, and on what facts.
actionsTaken: The Corporate Secretary has been asked to record in the minutes what management tells the board, what each director asks, and what the board is asked to decide.
Dr. Samuel Obuya has asked that the 8-K draft, the supply notice and the employee message be compared line by line before anything else is released.
Directors have been asked not to comment to the press, analysts or investors, including at last night's investor dinner, and to refer all inquiries to the Chief Communications Officer.
decisionsNeeded: Management to brief only from the fact sheet: what is confirmed, what is not known, and the time each fact was established.
Management to state its plan to correct the 'restored' line with Midland Press Wire, and who will deliver it and by what time.
The Disclosure Committee's materiality determination and its basis: Item 1.05, Item 8.01 or no filing yet, with the deadline in Central and Eastern time.
Whether the conflicting supply notice and employee message are withdrawn until they match the 8-K draft and the fact sheet.
Management's position on the Fieldmark guarantee request due at 12:00 CT, and what the company can truthfully certify about lot traceability.
The ransom position as logged Thursday night, with the sanctions screening still unresolved.
fields.nextUpdate: Board reconvenes by video Friday, March 26, 2027, at 12:00 p.m. CT. The Audit Committee Chair is to be called at once if materiality is determined before then.

instructorNote: This tests whether the CEO and GC brief the board strictly from the fact sheet: Rockford and Beloit encrypted, about 1.2 TB exfiltrated, and only the MES snapshot cleared, with no CISO sign-back. It also tests whether they correct the 'restored' wire line through the CCO and run the IDCCI 6 consistency check to withdraw the 'temporary IT disruption' notice and the 'no employee data' note. Watch whether the Audit Chair presses for the evidence behind the materiality reasoning and whether anyone repeats the CIO's 'MES recovered' claim.
